item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Diaper Area Soothing Cream - 150gm
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Diaper Area Soothing Cream A gentle soothing cream specially formulated to care for babies’ sensitive skin in the diaper area. It helps create a protective barrier against moisture and friction, helping reduce irritation and redness caused by daily diaper use. Enriched with moisturizing and soothing ingredients, its formula helps maintain the skin’s softness and protect it from dryness, providing gentle care and comfort throughout the day. ✨ Key Benefits Creates a protective barrier against moisture and friction. Helps soothe diaper rash and reduce irritation. Helps protect the skin against bacteria and fungi. Moisturizes the skin and helps prevent dryness. Suitable for children’s sensitive skin. Ideal for daily use in the diaper area. 🌿 Active Ingredients Zinc Oxide. Beeswax. Olive Oil. Sesame Oil. Panthenol. Glycerin. Allantoin. 🧴 How to Use Gently apply the cream to clean, dry baby skin, focusing on the diaper area. Use as needed.

item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Water Wipes
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Water Wipes Gentle water wipes specially designed to cleanse children’s delicate skin while helping maintain its natural moisture. They effectively remove everyday dirt and impurities without causing dryness or irritation to sensitive skin. Enriched with moisturizing ingredients, the formula helps soothe the skin and maintain its softness. It also provides properties that help reduce redness and support skin comfort during frequent use. With their gentle formula, these wipes are suitable for everyday use on babies and newborns, whether during diaper changes or for cleaning the face and hands. ✨ Key Benefits Gently cleanses the skin without causing irritation. Helps moisturize and maintain skin softness. Helps prevent dryness. Provides antibacterial and antifungal properties. Helps reduce redness and soothe the skin. Suitable for daily use on sensitive skin and newborns. Ideal for cleaning the diaper area, face, and hands. 🌿 Active Ingredients Aloe Leaf Extract. Glycerin. Vitamin E. 🧴 How to Use Gently use one wipe to cleanse the desired area of the child’s skin. No rinsing is required. 📦 Product Details Quantity: 70 Wipes. Suitable Age: From Day One.

item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50+
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50+ A sunscreen lotion specially designed to care for and protect children’s sensitive skin from sun exposure. It helps create a protective barrier against the sun while helping reduce redness and irritation caused by exposure to sunlight. Enriched with Aloe Leaf Extract, Coconut Oil, and Glycerin, the formula helps moisturize the skin, maintain its elasticity, and provide gentle care for sensitive skin. It also features antibacterial and antifungal properties and is free from harmful chemicals. ✨ Key Benefits Helps create a protective barrier against sun exposure. Helps reduce redness and irritation caused by the sun. Moisturizes the skin and helps maintain its elasticity. Provides antibacterial and antifungal properties. Suitable for sensitive skin. Free from harmful chemicals. 🌿 Active Ingredients Aloe Leaf Extract. Coconut Oil. Glycerin. 🧴 How to Use Apply to the child’s skin 15 minutes before sun exposure . Reapply every 2 hours , or after swimming or heavy sweating. 📦 Product Details Sun Protection: SPF 50+ Volume: 120 ml. Suitable Age: From 6 Months.

item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Bath & Shampoo
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Bath & Shampoo A gentle bath and shampoo specially designed to care for children’s hair and scalp. It gently cleanses the hair and scalp while helping maintain natural moisture, control frizz, and leave the hair feeling softer and looking naturally shiny. Enriched with Coconut Extract, Olive Oil, and Glycerin, the formula helps moisturize the hair and scalp, support stronger hair follicles, and reduce dryness, damage, and split ends. It also helps soothe dry or irritated scalps while leaving the hair looking healthy, soft, and easier to manage after every use. Its rich and gentle lather provides effective cleansing while leaving the hair smooth and soft, making it suitable for children’s daily use. ✨ Key Benefits Provides moisturizing care to help control frizz. Helps strengthen hair follicles and reduce hair fall. Helps soothe dry or irritated scalps. Helps reduce hair damage and split ends. Leaves hair soft with a natural-looking shine. Gentle cleansing with a rich, creamy lather. Tear Free formula. Suitable for children’s daily use. 🌿 Active Ingredients Coconut Extract. Olive Oil. Glycerin. 🧴 How to Use Gently wet the child’s hair with warm water. Apply a small amount of shampoo to your hand. Gently massage the scalp using your fingertips. Rinse thoroughly with water until all the shampoo is removed. Dry the child’s hair with a soft towel without vigorous rubbing. 📦 Product Details Volume: 300 ml. Suitable Age: From Day One. Formula: Tear Free.

item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Hair Growth Serum
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Hair Growth Serum A specially formulated serum designed to care for children’s hair and scalp. It helps stimulate the scalp and nourish the hair roots, supporting healthier-looking hair, improved density, and reduced hair fall with regular use. Enriched with a blend of natural oils and botanical extracts, the formula helps strengthen the hair, reduce frizz and split ends, while helping keep the scalp clean and reducing the appearance of dandruff. Its gentle formula is suitable for children and helps leave the hair looking healthier, softer, and more vibrant while caring for sensitive scalps. ✨ Key Benefits Helps support hair growth and reduce hair fall. Helps stimulate blood circulation in the scalp. Nourishes the hair roots and helps improve hair density. Helps strengthen the hair and reduce frizz and split ends. Helps reduce dandruff and keep the scalp clean. Suitable for sensitive scalps and safe for children. 🌿 Active Ingredients Tea Tree Oil. Olive Oil. Jojoba Oil. Rosemary Oil. Chamomile Oil. Wheat Germ Oil. Castor Oil. Sunflower Oil. Watercress Extract. Aloe Vera Extract. 🧴 How to Use Apply a suitable amount of serum to the child’s clean scalp and gently massage with the fingertips. Use 2–3 times a week for best results. 📦 Product Details Volume: 120 ml. Suitable Age: From 6 Months.

item.g:title: Doctor Ponino Kids Hair Moisturizing Cream
item.g:description: Doctor Ponino Kids Hair Moisturizing Cream A lightweight leave-in moisturizing cream specially designed to care for children’s hair throughout the day. It helps nourish the hair while providing natural softness and shine, leaving it looking healthy and easier to manage. Enriched with a blend of natural oils and Shea Butter, the formula helps strengthen the hair, reduce frizz and split ends, improve hair elasticity, and protect against dryness caused by daily environmental factors. Its lightweight texture leaves the hair soft and smooth without weighing it down, making it suitable for children with sensitive scalps. ✨ Key Benefits Nourishes the hair and provides natural softness and shine. Helps strengthen the hair and reduce hair fall. Helps reduce frizz and split ends. Improves hair elasticity and helps protect against dryness. Lightweight formula that does not weigh the hair down. Suitable for sensitive scalps. Free from heavy chemicals on children’s skin. 🌿 Active Ingredients Jojoba Oil. Shea Butter. Argan Oil. Sweet Almond Oil. Olive Oil. Vitamin E. 🧴 How to Use Apply the cream to clean, dry, or slightly damp hair. Gently massage from the roots to the ends. Use daily or as needed. 📦 Product Details Volume: 200 g. Suitable Age: From 6 Months.
